# dsh-memory-rules
> 安装见 INSTALL.md，隐私与数据边界见 PRIVACY.md。
**A local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness** — it learns facts about you across sessions, retri
eves them on every turn, consolidates them into beliefs on a schedule, and can carry your standing c
ollaboration rules. One SQLite file on your own disk.

- **Four layers** — world facts, experiences, beliefs, standing answers
- **Four retrieval paths** —

semantic, keyword, graph, timeline, merged with RRF
- **Editable rules** — prompt blocks live in a

table, not in the code
- **Zero network** — local feature-hash embedding, no telemetry (PRIVACY.md)
It replaces the v1 "one Markdown file per day" recorder. v3.0.0 merged the separate `dsh-user-rules`
bundle into this one, hence the name.
| **Database** | `~/.dsh/memory/memory.db` (`node:sqlite`, or `sql.js` as a fallback) — path unchang

ed by the merge |
| **Markdown** | `~/.dsh/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` per-day mirror, plus an export view

|
| **Tools** | `memory_write`, `memory_retrieve`, `memory_answer`, `memory_reflect`, `memory_relat

e`, `memory_export`, `memory_search` |
| **Hooks** | `agent/pre-step` (recall), `session/event` + `a

gent/status` (write), 7-day timer (reflect) |
| **System prompt** | `memory-rules` context at order

120 (提示词 blocks), `memory:recall` at order 150 (memory guidance) |
| **Web UI** | 左侧导航「记忆与规则」（`上下文洞察
` 下方）：「信念库」+「提示词」两个标签 |
## v3.2.0 — tagged injection, a real write gate, and a second retrieval source
The 2026-11-01 upgrade. Four things changed; each one is measured, not asserted.

**1. The injected block is structured.** It used to be one undifferentiated
paragraph, so the model

could not tell a memory from an instruction and a program
could not drop a whole entry when the budg

memory from an instruction and a program
could not drop a whole entry when the budget ran out. Now:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The block is inserted **before** the turn's own words (`recallPosition`), because
appending leaves a

page of background text exactly where the model looks for the
newest instruction.

**2. The write gate judges the source, then the text.** The runtime snapshot
arrives as `role: 'user

'` messages in pieces, so the old message-level guard
never saw it: **233 of 709 facts (33%) were `T

ime sampled while preparing turn N…`
and friends**. Now only messages that declare `source.kind ===

'user'` are
extracted (with a legacy fallback), and a line-prefix denylist catches the pieces.
A twe
nty-turn replay test asserts the store stays clean.

**3. Beliefs get a reserved slot.** `beliefs.priority` (`normal|global`) plus
`recallBeliefSlot` put

the strongest persona belief into every turn regardless of
similarity — similarity is exactly what
drops it on an unrelated question.

**4. The knowledge base was removed (2026-11-01).** `lib/kb.js`, the `kb-*` config
keys, the `mcp-kb

` MCP row and the cross-source fusion were cut when the local KB
was detached from this package. The

memory store is now the only recall source and
the injected block carries `user_long_term_memories`

/ `standing_answer` only.
Pre-cut copies live in the `_detach-*` / `_detach2-*` backup folders.

Ranking was recalibrated at the same time: confidence weight 0.35 → 0.20 (it is
query-independent, a

nd 58% of rows sit at the 0.72 default), RRF normalised by
the **observed** best instead of a consta

nt that saturated at 1.0, and the three
terms now sum to 1.0. Offline A/B on one frozen snapshot (`t
ools/eval-retrieval.mjs`):
| arm | hit@1 | hit@6 | MRR |

## Upgrading from `dsh-plugin-memory@2.2.0` + `dsh-user-rules@0.1.0`

v3.0.0 merges the two retired packages into this one. Nothing is rewritten: the
database path, the s

even tool names, the Markdown mirror and the recall context
(`memory:recall`, order 150) are unchang

ed — the upgrade adds exactly one table
and one seed row.

1. Install this package and remove `dsh-plugin-memory` and `dsh-user-rules` from
the profile's `depe

ndencies` **and** `dsh.profile.bundles`, then run
`pnpm install`.
2. Restart DSH. The first `service

.migrate()` creates `prompt_blocks` and seeds
`id='user-rules'` with `lib/rules.js`'s `RULES`. The s

eed only runs when the
table is empty, so a later restart never overwrites an edited block.
3. Open

「记忆与规则 → 提示词」 and confirm a single row, 用户硬性协作流程 · 内置.
The system prompt must carry the four rules e

xactly once, ahead of the memory
guidance.
4. Only after that check, delete the two old plugin direc

tories and run
`pnpm install` again to drop their `node_modules` junctions.
What changes, and only this:
| | before | after |
| package / plugin id | `dsh-plugin-memory` (+ `dsh-user-rules`) | `dsh-memory-rules`, id `memory-ru

les` |
| rules context | `user-rules` @ 120 | `memory-rules` @ 120 |
| rules storage | constant insi

de `dsh-user-rules` | `prompt_blocks` row, editable in 提示词 |
| 信念库 | had 添加 / 归档 | edit + real delet

user-rules` | `prompt_blocks` row, editable in 提示词 |
| 信念库 | had 添加 / 归档 | edit + real delete only |

Rollback: stop DSH, restore both directories and the old `package.json` from a
backup, `pnpm install

`, restart. `prompt_blocks` is additive and v2 ignores it,
so the data itself needs no rollback.
## 记忆与规则 (Web UI)

v3.0.0 points the browser half (`lib/client.js`, `dsh.client.platform = "web"`)
at one page with two

tabs, both served by the same Host service and the same
database:

* **信念库** (beliefs, the default tab) — the 观察信念层. It exists for
*认知纠偏与人机对齐*: background consolidatio

n can infer a belief the user
disagrees with, so the tab can correct the wording and delete a belief

the
user does not want. There is deliberately **no add entry**: beliefs come from
consolidation and

from older stores, and a rule the user wants the Agent to
follow belongs in 提示词, not in a hand-writ

ten belief.
* **提示词** (prompts) — the ordered blocks injected into the system prompt on
every reques

t, including the seeded `prompt_blocks.id='user-rules'` row that
carries the hard collaboration rule

including the seeded `prompt_blocks.id='user-rules'` row that
carries the hard collaboration rules.
